'''Injaye''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3640 BBY]], she was one of the many [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] that were sent to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to help the people during the [[Battle of Corellia]]. However, Injaye secretly acted as a spy to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Baras]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]], having infiltrated the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] a decade before. When Baras started his [[Darth Baras's coup|plot]] to usurp the position of the [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Voice of the Emperor]], the loyalist [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of the [[Hand of the Empire|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mission to Corellia (Emperor's Wrath)|sent]] the [[Empire's Wrath|new Emperor Wrath]] to assist [[Darth Vowrawn]], who suggested eliminating all of Baras' agents on Corellia. Eventually, the Wrath and their allies discovered the true loyalty of Injaye from Vowrawn's operative [[Shadow]] and set out to confront her. Injaye fought alongside Masters [[Rubatin]] and [[Joce]] to defeat the Wrath, but her allies all defeated. After watching Rubatin and Joce die, Injaye revealed herself to the Wrath as a spy. She knew that Darth Baras would proclaim himself as the Voice for the Emperor and slowly died from her wounds.<ref name="SW TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Depending on player choice, Injaye's ultimate fate within the game can change. When confronting the Jedi, the player can expose Injaye as a Sith spy either by tricking her into believing the Wrath is there to wipe out the Jedi, or by getting [[Jaesa Willsaam]], one of the Wrath's companions, to sense the alignments and feelings of everyone in the room. Either way, they may then kill her and leave, let the Jedi take her into their custody, or proceed to kill both her and the rest of the Jedi anyway.<ref name="SW TOR" />
